scope: Supplement to source-conversion-model-wip-review-r1. This correction re-evaluates the reviewed_at finding against the exact R1/R3 and source-publication R3 text. No production source, test source, Git, Vault, network, operator or human-gate mutation was performed.

correction.reason: The exact frozen contract deliberately permits this migration. SOURCE-CONVERSION-R1 says a v2 publication migration may add reviewed_at:null to a historical nonaccepted row. SOURCE-CONVERSION-R3 repeats that missing reviewed_at keys gain only null. SOURCE-PUBLICATION-R3 explains that the complete prospective typed state requires reviewed_at as a key for every claim row once a v2 paper/event is introduced, while the pure legacy structural baseline may preserve absent raw keys. Therefore selected-claim-only insertion would fail complete mixed-state validation under the current source_state contract.
preserved_boundary: The migration may add only reviewed_at:null to nonaccepted rows missing that key across the complete claim ledger when the conversion introduces v2 state.
Accepted rows must retain a valid reviewed_at date; no accepted status or human review is synthesized.

Every existing row retains exact text, owner, assessment, evidence, event history and raw optional notes/supersedes presence/value. reviewed_at:null is the sole allowed newly present key for an otherwise absent nonaccepted row.
The legacy baseline remains byte-preserving until the explicit v2 overlay; no-op on an already modern state must not rewrite timestamps or rows.
correction.required_clarification_test: Add an adversarial mixed legacy fixture with an unrelated paper/repository claim lacking reviewed_at. Assert conversion succeeds, the unrelated claim's only permitted row delta is reviewed_at:null, its text/owner/assessment/evidence/history and notes/supersedes presence remain exact, and no unrelated event is created. This is a contract clarification and regression test, not a blocker in the current implementation.

remaining_finding.finding: When a selected source lacks the target paper page, assemble_conversion appends the page without sorting. The publication preservation check requires changed source pages to equal sorted(set(pages)), so a source already linked to a lexicographically later page can make an otherwise valid conversion fail.
remaining_finding.contract_basis: source_state.preserve_history.py:533-540 rejects changed source pages that are not sorted and unique; SOURCE-CONVERSION-R1 requires page links for every source attached to a changed paper or claim while retaining publication validation.
remaining_finding.required_fix: Build the changed pages field as sorted(set(existing_pages + [page])) and retain complete-page validation. Add a fixture where an existing source page sorts after the selected page, plus duplicate and unknown-page refusal checks.

positive_paths_reconfirmed: Association reuse/version disambiguation delegates to complete inventory and earliest registration proof.
Claim identity, owner/ref collision, evidence fingerprint, event reason and summary partition logic align with R3.
Metadata canonical identity, aliases, date union and proposed_at chronology align with R1/R2.
The orchestrator passes one retained Vault snapshot/current state through prospective collection and the retained publication helper.

implementation_boundary.allowed: This supplement records review evidence and a contract correction only.
